A brave adventurer died facing the terrible {creature:Braindeath}. Go to {wiki:Fenrock|Fenrock}, near {wiki:Beregar|Beregar}, kill the Braindeath next to the lava and open the right coffin to get the adventurer's backpack: a {item:Red Backpack} with potions, tools and 13 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
A brave adventurer died fighting the evil Braindeath.
No minimum level, but level 70+ is recommended.
Having completed the {wiki:The Hidden City of Beregar Quest|The Hidden City of Beregar Quest} makes it easier (you can use the transport system); otherwise, you have to walk to Beregar.
to use on the Fenrock crack (entrance to Beregar)
On the way there you will meet {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms} and several kinds of goblins.
In the quest area there are {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Gozzler|Gozzlers}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords} and 1 {creature:Braindeath}.
{wiki:Beregar|Beregar} is a dwarven city hidden beneath the island of {wiki:Fenrock|Fenrock}, west of {wiki:Yalahar|Yalahar}. You need a {item:Pick} to get in the first time.

In {wiki:Yalahar|Yalahar}, go to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter|Foreigner Quarter} (all the way **northwest**, 1 floor above ground) and talk to {npc:Maris}. Say {key:hi}, {key:fenrock} and {key:yes} (100 gp).

If you have never been to Beregar: first ask Maris for passage to **Mistrock** ({key:mistrock}) and, once in Mistrock, say {key:hi} and {key:Mistrock} to him. Only then go to Fenrock (50 gp from Mistrock). Without this conversation, the {item:Pick} does not work on the Fenrock crack.

In Fenrock, go into the mountain and down to **floor -2**, where there are {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} and {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}. In the **southeast** corner there is a crack in the stone floor: use the {item:Pick} on it and you are teleported down.
Head to {wiki:Beregar|Beregar}. If you have already completed the {wiki:The Hidden City of Beregar Quest|The Hidden City of Beregar Quest}, use that quest's transport system; otherwise, go on foot.

The transport is the **ore wagon**, which sits at the start of the path, after the crack: use it and you save the walk to Beregar. It only works once you have activated it (on your first visit, when you meet {npc:Nokmir}, walk a little **south**, go up the ramp and use the wagon on the yellow floor).
Ore cart on the Fenrock side

Without the wagon activated, follow the path down from the crack. You will only meet {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Goblin|Goblins} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}; you will pass an ore wagon that you cannot use yet. Keep going until you find the first dwarf NPC ({npc:Nokmir}).
The path from the Fenrock crack to Beregar
If you take a wrong path you may end up in areas with {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. If you see them, turn back.
Follow the path in the image
From Beregar, follow the path in the image, part by part, to {wiki:Fenrock|Fenrock}.
Path to the Braindeath (numbered parts; the Braindeath is in part 5, next to the lava)
Near the lava, in **part 5** of the map, there is 1 {creature:Braindeath}. Kill it.
This area also has {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}.
After killing the Braindeath, open the {item:Coffin|coffin} on the **right** to receive the reward.
{item:Red Backpack} with 2 {item:Great Health Potion|Great Health Potions}, 1 {item:Mana Potion}, 1 {item:Shovel}, 1 {item:Rope} and 13 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}

Go back along the same path in the image to Beregar. If you have the ore wagon activated, use Beregar's wagon to return to the Fenrock side; otherwise, retrace on foot the path you came by. Then go back the same way to the surface of Fenrock and talk to {npc:Maris} at the island's dock: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}.
